This material is separate from mgfe94o\_b1 because the article fits the rhombohedral observations with an independent extrapolated V0, K0, and K0-prime. The 300 K EOS is not a spin-resolved parameterization: SMS points lie above the diffraction range and do not supply simultaneous volume observations for high-spin, low-spin, or mixed-spin branches.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: article sections 2.1, 3, and 3.2; article Table 1; official supplement Table S1 and Figure S2.
- **Equation:** Article section 3.2, Table 1, and Supplementary Figure S2: third-order Birch-Murnaghan isothermal EOS fitted with MINUTI 2.0.0.
- **V0:** Article Table 1 and section 3.2: 9.59(10) A^3/atom, freely fitted and extrapolated; multiplied by two atoms per Mg0.058Fe0.942O formula unit.
- **K0:** Article section 3.2 and Table 1: K0T=217(19) GPa, freely fitted.
- **K0 prime:** Article section 3.2 and Table 1: K0T'=2.06(22), freely fitted with no stated prior.
- **Volume basis:** Supplementary Table S1 and Figure S2 label volume as A^3/atom. The explicit primitive EOS basis contains one Mg0.058Fe0.942O formula unit and two atoms, so V and sigmaV are multiplied by two without changing K0 or K0\_prime. No unreported conventional-cell metric is required.
- **Reference temperature (K):** Supplementary Figure S2 identifies the isotherm as 300 K.
- **Uncertainties:** Table S1 gives parenthetical pressure and volume errors. Pressure error is the reported difference among ruby determinations before and after diffraction; the source gives no confidence convention for volume or parameter errors.

</details>

## Observation datasets

### mgfe94o\_dobrosavljevic\_2019\_table\_s1\_compression

- **Description:** All 28 P-V rows printed in official Supplementary Table S1, including the 16 B1 observations and 12 rhombohedral observations.
- **Kind:** multiphase\_pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Dobrosavljevic; Sturhahn; Jackson
    - **Year:** 2019
    - **Title:** Evaluating the Role of Iron-Rich (Mg,Fe)O in Ultralow Velocity Zones
    - **Source:** Minerals

- **Source location:** Official supplement, Table S1
- **Associated EOS records:** mgfe94o\_rhombohedral\_dobrosavljevic\_2019\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** The paper describes 27 compression points, while Table S1 prints 28 rows because measurement P8 is split into P8a and P8b; no row is discarded.
